full_prompt_en: A square architectural photograph frames an ornate blue-gray and cream facade straight on, its curving Art Nouveau ornament filling almost the entire view beneath a pale overcast sky. A narrow strip of gray street and sidewalk runs along the bottom edge, giving the building a level base and a calm urban setting. The facade is nearly symmetrical around a central entrance, but its decorative lines flow rather than obeying a rigid grid. On the left and right, two raised end bays have dark blue curved rooflines and tall cream surrounds framing stacked windows. Each end bay projects slightly forward through a rounded balcony at mid-height, while narrow dark window recesses repeat farther inward. At the upper center, a taller ornamental crown rises above the roof edge, its cream and warm tan relief surrounded by blue-gray wall sections. Long vertical cream pilasters descend from the crown toward the doorway, broken by rounded medallions and small floral-looking plaster details. The main entrance sits in a shallow arched recess at the lower center, with warm amber light visible beneath a small projecting canopy and a brown door set back behind it. At either side of the doorway, slim windows and warm cream bands hold the central ornament in balance. Two young street trees partially soften the lower corners without hiding the building's main pattern. Smooth painted wall planes contrast with raised stucco relief, the weathered dark base, and glass that appears pale and slightly reflective. Cloud-filtered daylight falls evenly across the face of the building, making the cream decoration stand out through color and shallow relief rather than harsh shadow; the doorway provides the strongest warm dark accent. The full facade reads as one interlaced composition of curved profiles, vertical rhythm, restrained color, and delicate surface work, with the empty foreground allowing its ornament to remain the focus.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形建筑照片从正面框住一面华丽的蓝灰与奶油色外墙，流动的装饰几乎占满整幅画面，上方只有一条阴天的浅色天空。底边延伸着狭窄的灰色街道和人行道，为建筑提供水平基座与安静的城市环境。外墙以中央入口近乎对称，但装饰线条流畅，并不完全服从僵硬网格。左右两个抬高的端部开间有深蓝色弧形屋顶线，修长的奶油色边框围住上下排列的窗户。每个端部开间在中段通过圆弧阳台略向前凸，较内侧还重复着狭窄的深色窗洞。上方正中，一座较高的装饰性顶部越过屋檐，奶油色与暖棕色浮雕由蓝灰墙面环绕。细长的奶油色壁柱从顶部向门口延伸，中间点缀圆形饰章和似花草的灰泥细部。主入口位于下方中央的浅拱龛内，小小突出的雨篷下透出暖琥珀色灯光，棕色门扇后退于其中。门两侧的细窗和暖奶油色水平带使中央装饰保持平衡。两棵年轻街树轻轻柔化下方角落，却没有遮住建筑的主要图案。平滑的涂色墙面与凸起的灰泥浮雕、风化的深色基座以及显得浅淡而略带反光的玻璃形成对比。云层过滤的日光均匀落在外墙上，让奶油色装饰主要凭色彩和浅浮雕而非强烈阴影显现；门口则提供最鲜明的暖色暗部。整面外墙形成由弯曲轮廓、竖向节奏、克制配色和细腻表面工艺交织的构图，空旷前景让装饰保持焦点。
style_prompt_en: A frontal photographic style gives elaborate relief a clear, nearly symmetrical structure. Blue-gray painted planes occupy broad areas, while pale cream and muted tan lines curl around openings and run down narrow vertical strips. Raised ornament creates fine changes of edge and texture against smoother recessed fields, and dark apertures punctuate the lighter pattern at measured intervals. The overall palette stays subdued, with a small warm amber accent near the lower center. Cloud-softened light keeps shadows shallow and color differences legible; depth comes from projecting curved bands, inset surfaces, and slight reflections rather than dramatic contrast. A level base and repeated vertical bays hold the flowing motifs in an orderly rhythm, producing an elegant balance between disciplined geometry and organic movement.
style_prompt_zh: 正面的摄影表现给繁密浮雕一个清晰、近乎对称的结构。蓝灰色涂绘平面占据大面积，浅奶油色与柔和棕色线条围绕开口弯曲，并沿狭长竖带下行。凸起装饰在平滑的内凹色域前形成细微的边缘与肌理变化，深色开口按稳定间距点缀浅色图案。整体色调克制，下方中央只有一小处暖琥珀色强调。云层柔化的光使阴影很浅，色彩差别仍清晰；纵深来自突出的弧带、内嵌表面和轻微反光，而非戏剧性反差。水平基底与重复竖向分区把流动花纹纳入有序节奏，在严谨几何与有机动势之间形成优雅平衡。
theme_en: An ornate blue and cream Art Nouveau facade on a quiet street
theme_zh: 安静街道上一面蓝色与奶油色装饰外墙
name: Art Nouveau architecture
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
